title: Server Service Test Coverage Gap Remediation

sprint.goal: Add unit tests for the four runtime-critical server services that currently have zero dedicated test files: Scheduler, EpisodeService, SeriesService, and MediaSearchService. The lower-risk services (Settings, TvSearch, the three Subtitle services, FilterService) are deferred to a post-v1.0 follow-up track.
sprint.demo_notes: Show 4 new test suites green; Scheduler cron registration verified; Episode/Series CRUD and MediaSearch aggregation covered
